missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Мальчишка' is grammatically masculine but declines like a feminine -а noun. It stays nominative as the subject. 'Весёлый' takes the masculine form, matching natural gender.

Strategic focus: Accusative of an animate noun. 'Мальчишку' takes the -у accusative ending of -а nouns. Because the boy is animate, the demonstrative 'этого' shows the animate accusative equals the genitive form.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Мальчишки' is the genitive form after 'у' to mark whose. 'Нет велосипеда' uses the genitive of absence. A core possession-and-lack pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Мальчишке' is the dative form marking the recipient of the gift. 'Яблоко' is the accusative object given. A core giving pattern with an indirect object.

Strategic focus: Instrumental object. 'Мальчишкой' is the instrumental form required after 'гордиться', which governs the instrumental. 'Этим' agrees in the instrumental. A core verb-plus-instrumental pattern.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О мальчишке' uses the prepositional form after 'об' to express the topic. 'Этом' agrees in the prepositional. A clean topic-of-conversation pattern.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with motion. 'Мальчишка' is the nominative subject of 'бежит'. 'По двору' uses the dative after 'по' to mark movement around the yard. A natural action scene.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Мальчишки' is the nominative plural subject of 'играют'. 'Соседние' is the agreeing plural adjective, and 'в футбол' names the game. Good for plural practice.

Strategic focus: Genitive plural of animates after a numeral. 'Мальчишек' is the genitive plural, used after 'двух' and for the animate accusative plural. 'Учитель' is the nominative subject. A core counting-people pattern.

Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Мальчишка' is the nominative subject of 'любит'. 'Маленький' takes the masculine form, agreeing with natural gender despite the -а ending. A clean descriptive pattern.
